mapper.sql: id, subordinate_employee_id, manager_employee_id, relation_type, status, active_direct_marker, effective_from, effective_to, reason, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by

reporting.id, reporting.subordinate_employee_id, reporting.manager_employee_id, reporting.relation_type, reporting.status, reporting.active_direct_marker, reporting.effective_from, reporting.effective_to, reporting.reason, reporting.version, reporting.create_time, reporting.create_by, reporting.edit_time, reporting.edit_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id = #{subordinateEmployeeId} AND relation_type = 'DIRECT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_direct_marker = 1 AND effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC

SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting reporting INNER JOIN t_employee manager_employee ON manager_employee.id = reporting.manager_employee_id AND manager_employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN t_user manager_account ON manager_account.id = manager_employee.user_id AND manager_account.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND manager_account.account_enabled = 1 AND manager_account.account_no_locked = 1 AND manager_account.account_no_expired = 1 AND manager_account.credentials_no_expired = 1 AND manager_account.manual_locked = 0 AND (manager_account.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR manager_account.auto_locked_until <= #{effectiveAt}) AND (manager_account.account_expires_at IS NULL OR manager_account.account_expires_at > #{effectiveAt}) AND (manager_account.password_expires_at IS NULL OR manager_account.password_expires_at > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment manager_assignment ON manager_assignment.employee_id = manager_employee.id AND manager_assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND manager_assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND manager_assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 AND manager_assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (manager_assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR manager_assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit manager_organization ON manager_organization.id = manager_assignment.organization_unit_id AND manager_organization.enabled = 1 AND manager_organization.placeholder = 0 INNER JOIN t_position manager_position ON manager_position.id = manager_assignment.position_id AND manager_position.enabled = 1 AND manager_position.code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE reporting.subordinate_employee_id = #{subordinateEmployeeId} AND reporting.status = 'ACTIVE' AND reporting.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (reporting.effective_to IS NULL OR reporting.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY CASE reporting.relation_type WHEN 'ACTING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, reporting.effective_from DESC, reporting.id DESC

SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting reporting INNER JOIN t_employee manager_employee ON manager_employee.id = reporting.manager_employee_id AND manager_employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN t_user manager_account ON manager_account.id = manager_employee.user_id AND manager_account.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND manager_account.account_enabled = 1 AND manager_account.account_no_locked = 1 AND manager_account.account_no_expired = 1 AND manager_account.credentials_no_expired = 1 AND manager_account.manual_locked = 0 AND (manager_account.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR manager_account.auto_locked_until <= #{effectiveAt}) AND (manager_account.account_expires_at IS NULL OR manager_account.account_expires_at > #{effectiveAt}) AND (manager_account.password_expires_at IS NULL OR manager_account.password_expires_at > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment manager_assignment ON manager_assignment.employee_id = manager_employee.id AND manager_assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND manager_assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND manager_assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 AND manager_assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (manager_assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR manager_assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit manager_organization ON manager_organization.id = manager_assignment.organization_unit_id AND manager_organization.enabled = 1 AND manager_organization.placeholder = 0 INNER JOIN t_position manager_position ON manager_position.id = manager_assignment.position_id AND manager_position.enabled = 1 AND manager_position.code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE reporting.manager_employee_id = #{managerEmployeeId} AND reporting.status = 'ACTIVE' AND reporting.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (reporting.effective_to IS NULL OR reporting.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY reporting.subordinate_employee_id, CASE reporting.relation_type WHEN 'ACTING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id = #{subordinateEmployeeId} ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id = #{subordinateEmployeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED', 'ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id=#{subordinateEmployeeId} AND relation_type='DIRECT' AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id=#{subordinateEmployeeId} AND relation_type='ACTING' AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND effective_to>#{effectiveAt} ORDER BY manager_employee_id,effective_to,id

SELECT FROM t_employee_reporting WHERE subordinate_employee_id=#{subordinateEmployeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{effectiveFrom}) AND (#{effectiveTo} IS NULL OR effective_from<#{effectiveTo}) ORDER BY effective_from,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_employee_reporting (subordinate_employee_id, manager_employee_id, relation_type, status, active_direct_marker, effective_from, effective_to, reason, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{subordinateEmployeeId}, #{managerEmployeeId}, #{relationType}, #{status}, #{activeDirectMarker}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{reason}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
